rounds.q: What % of US recorded music money now comes from streaming?
rounds.why: Paid subscriptions alone made up 55% of it, and downloads just 2%.
rounds.src: RIAA, 2025 Year-End Revenue Report, wholesale (2025 data)
rounds.fun: 82% streaming, and paid subscriptions alone were 55%. Downloads? Just 2%. Bye, buy button!

rounds.q: What % of US adults played a musical instrument in the past year?
rounds.why: 20% of adults sang that year, alone, with friends, or in a choir.
rounds.src: National Endowment for the Arts, Arts Participation Patterns in 2022 (2022 data)
rounds.fun: About 1 in 9 adults played an instrument, but 20% sang. The singers win this round!

rounds.q: A grand piano has 88 keys. About how many strings are inside it?
rounds.why: Those strings pull with up to about 20 tons of force, so the piano needs an iron frame.
rounds.src: HyperPhysics, Georgia State University, The Piano; Steinway & Sons, Model M (tension)
rounds.fun: About 230 strings for 88 keys, pulling up to 20 tons. Mighty strong piano!

rounds.q: How many vinyl records were sold in the US in 2025?
rounds.why: Vinyl outsold CDs for the fourth year in a row, 46.8 million to 29.5 million.
rounds.fun: About 47 million records spun their way home, beating CDs four years running!

rounds.q: Bands tune to the A above middle C. How many times a second does it vibrate?
rounds.why: A US government radio station has broadcast that exact tone since 1936.
rounds.src: NIST, Time and Frequency from A to Z: A440
rounds.fun: 440 wiggles a second, and the radio has been playing it since 1936. Tune up!
